title: Golden Analyst Report (P5A)
description: Canonical schema for golden analyst reports consumed by the P5A scoring framework. Recommendation enum and period regex reflect shipped Python schema (python-services/src/financex/schemas/analyst.py) and shipped period suffix convention. Operator-curated golden facts MUST be normalized to the lowercase English enum at extraction time; Turkish display values (AL/TUT/SAT) do not appear here.

_warning.description: Optional inline warning text for synthetic / non-authoritative fixtures. Conventional underscore prefix marks informational metadata.

period.description: Period suffix matching the shipped fact-layer convention: fy2025 / q3_2025 / h1_2025 / YYYYMMDD.

synthetic_fixture.description: REQUIRED to be true for non-authoritative test fixtures (P5A test data). Reports curated from real analyst sources omit this field or set it to false. Scoring CLI logs a clear warning when scoring against a synthetic_fixture report so operators are not misled.

report_date.description: ISO-8601 date when the analyst report was published.

expected_facts.description: Map of fact_key (snake_case, period-suffixed) to expected value with optional unit and tolerance.

value.description: Expected value. Number for numeric facts; string for categorical facts.

unit.description: Canonical unit (e.g., TRY_mn, decimal, x, days). Empty string permitted for unitless facts.

tolerance_pct.description: Per-fact override of the default 0.02 (2%) numeric tolerance.

expected_narratives.description: List of topics and the key points each topic should cover in the actual report.

expected_conclusions.description: Operator-supplied analyst-firm conclusions normalized to the shipped Python Recommendation enum.

recommendation.description: Lowercase 6-value enum matching python-services/src/financex/schemas/analyst.py:14-20. Turkish display values (AL/TUT/SAT/GUCLU AL/GUCLU SAT) MUST be normalized at extraction time.

target_price_try.description: Target price in TRY (single point estimate).

target_price_range.description: [low, high] target price band in TRY.
